profiles.region_scope: public pinnacle.com rule page; no account jurisdiction asserted

summary.overtime: Game and second-half periods include overtime.
summary.minimum_duration: NBA game-period bets void below 43 minutes completed.
summary.delayed_start: General rule voids fixtures not started within 12 hours of scheduled start.
summary.completion_window: General rule voids started fixtures unfinished within 30 hours of planned start, subject to sport/market exceptions.
summary.draw: Two-way moneyline without a draw option voids if a draw occurs.
summary.precedence: Market rules override sport rules, which override general rules.

profiles.region_scope: Rendered sportsbook.draftkings.com pages include Ontario footer links; confirm applicability when binding each quote.

summary.overtime: Standard full-game markets include overtime; specified three-way/quarter and aggregate-scoring exceptions exist.
summary.delayed_start: General rules use two calendar days from scheduled start date in stadium local time; basketball postseason rule extends to four.
summary.interruption: Basketball distinguishes interruptions with at least five regulation minutes remaining from later interruptions, using two-day/four-day conclusion windows.
summary.moneyline: For qualifying resumed/concluded interrupted games, full-game moneyline uses the declared winner; other market treatment can differ.
summary.late_interruption: Certain late interrupted games not concluded within the applicable window settle using last-play statistics.

comparisons.reason: Different delay/interruption/void treatment; per-quote rule binding also pending. Future matching must preserve distinct profiles and define an explicit compatibility policy rather than equating these rules.
